sentence: Whether key account managers take up AI at all depends on their personality traits, and organizational culture moderates the link
passage: [Mehta et al. (2025), p. 543] "Our research shows that key account managers' adoption of AI technologies is influenced significantly by personality traits." / "Organisational culture significantly moderates the association between agreeableness and the adoption of AI technologies."

gemini.note: The sentence generalizes the moderating effect of organizational culture to all personality traits, whereas the passage only specifies this effect for the trait of agreeableness.
